title: The Death Game Report
description:
"Submit your report. Immediately."
The Bureau of Records handed you a single task: restore the complete record of the death game held on a remote island a few days ago, and submit a report.

All that remains are the records the dead left behind in their final moments, and a single terminal.
Your job is to restore those records one by one, and bring to light the truth of every death on the island.

About the GameYou work at a single, aging terminal.

Type in a record name to restore a broken record, and read the memory the victim left behind in their final moments.
Cross-reference the clues scattered through the record against the student roster and the island map, and work out the cause, the weapon, and the culprit for each death, one at a time.

Every time three correct reports line up, they're confirmed.
With each one you fill in, the remaining records connect to one another and the shape of the next death begins to emerge.

• Your only clues: the victims' records, the student roster, and the island map

• Identify and report the cause, the weapon, and the culprit for every student

• A hint system for when you get stuck

• Around 5 hours to complete
Streaming & Let's PlaysStreaming and Let's Plays are welcome, whether you're an individual or a company, and monetization is fine.
If you can, we'd appreciate it if you'd include this store page's URL in your video description.
description_short: Identify how every participant in the death game died, and submit your report.
